observations.title: Animate native interactive blocks
observations.player_action: Open a native door, trapdoor or fence gate, or interact with supported switches and containers.
observations.outcome: Supported client block transitions animate smoothly; the server's block state and interaction validation remain native.
conditions: Newer author pages list blocks absent from Minecraft 1.20.1; do not promise vaults or other later-version content.
Author documentation can cover newer releases; installed version is 1.2.31.
observations.review_note: Exact quest criterion and world-state result were not exercised; a custom signal must observe the action, not a manual checkmark.

observations.title: Configure animation compatibility
observations.player_action: Use the installed configuration interface and per-block exclusions when preparing resource-pack compatibility.
observations.outcome: Author configuration supports turning animation paths off for conflicting block or mod content; this research does not alter those settings.
conditions: Current docs describe /fwaConfig, fwa.json and a fwa-blacklist.json exclusion file; verify names against the installed version before use.
Author documentation can cover newer releases; installed version is 1.2.31.
